name: quizdeck
description: Live quiz platform — host builds and presents, the room answers from their phones.

scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
